Hero.headline: India deserves functioning systems.
Hero.subheadline: Nagrik Party exists because daily life governance has failed.

Failure.headline: Daily Governance Failure
Failure.desc: The collapse of daily life is not accidental. Broken roads, flooded streets, and overcrowded hospitals are political decisions born from systemic neglect.

CitizenFirst.headline: Citizen First Governance
CitizenFirst.desc: We believe in a system where public dignity is the baseline, not a luxury. Every policy, every infrastructure project must start from the citizen's lived reality.

Dignity.headline: Dignity Infrastructure
Dignity.desc: Governance is visible. When infrastructure works, dignity is restored. Our mission is to rebuild the systems that touch daily lives: from clean water to safe commutes.

Healthcare.headline: Healthcare Localization
Healthcare.desc: Decentralizing care means ensuring no one travels hours for basic treatment. One fully equipped clinic per ward is a fundamental right.

WomenSafety.headline: Women Safety
WomenSafety.desc: True safety requires illuminated streets, active community monitoring, and zero tolerance for systemic blind spots.

Accountability.headline: Public Accountability
Accountability.desc: Tax liya hai toh kaam bhi dikhao. We demand transparent, public audits of every local project.

Youth.headline: Youth Future
Youth.desc: An entire generation cannot wait. We are fighting to create a localized economy that values skills and provides real opportunities.

Intro.headline: From the streets of Delhi, a civic awakening.
Intro.desc: This is not a story of a destined messiah. This is the story of citizens who watched systems fail repeatedly and decided to organize.

Journey.headline: The Independent Election Journey
Journey.desc: Arsalan Azad stepped into the 2025 Delhi Elections not as a traditional politician, but as a frustrated citizen demanding visible governance. The 'Chimta' symbol became a representation of grassroots, household resilience.

Grassroots.headline: Grassroots Issue Solving
Grassroots.desc: Before the party existed, there was the work. Fixing streetlights, cleaning mohallas, demanding answers. The movement grew from the exhaustion of waiting for someone else to do it.

Creation.headline: Why Nagrik Party Was Created
Creation.desc: We realized that activism without political power hits a ceiling. To fix the systems, we had to become the system. A hyper-local governance operating system.

Vision.headline: Civic Governance Vision
Vision.desc: We are building an architecture of accountability. A party where local ward captains are the true leaders, and where every taxpayer knows exactly where their money goes.

Outro.headline: Someone trying to build systems where systems failed.
Outro.desc: This movement is for anyone who is tired of the struggle. It's time for visible governance.

Hero.headline: Everything is Breaking.
Hero.subheadline: These are not statistics. These are daily lives.

womenSafety.title: Women Safety
womenSafety.desc: Dark streets, broken CCTV, absent police presence. Safety is not a poster — it's infrastructure.

roads.title: Roads & Infrastructure
roads.desc: Potholes that break bones, waterlogged streets that drown vehicles, construction that never ends.

water.title: Water Supply
water.desc: Contaminated water, broken pipelines, water tanker mafias. Clean drinking water remains a luxury.

sewage.title: Sewage & Drainage
sewage.desc: Open drains, overflowing sewage in monsoons, diseases breeding in stagnant water.

healthcare.title: Healthcare Access
healthcare.desc: Hours of waiting, unavailable beds, staff shortages. Public healthcare has become indignity.

homelessness.title: Homelessness
homelessness.desc: Thousands sleep on footpaths. No shelters, no rehabilitation, no dignity.

addiction.title: Addiction Crisis
addiction.desc: Substance abuse destroying youth. No rehabilitation centres, no political will, no solutions.

youthUnemployment.title: Youth Unemployment
youthUnemployment.desc: Degrees without jobs. Skills without opportunities. An entire generation stuck.

garbage.title: Garbage & Sanitation
garbage.desc: Overflowing bins, uncleared garbage, burning waste. Breathing has become hazardous.

publicInfra.title: Public Infrastructure
publicInfra.desc: Broken streetlights, missing footpaths, non-functional public toilets. Basic infrastructure is absent.

Hero.headline: Ward-Level Infrastructure Mission
Hero.subheadline: Tax liya hai toh kaam bhi dikhao. Here's what every constituency deserves.

hospital.title: 1 Hospital per Vidhan Sabha
hospital.desc: 24/7 Level-1 trauma care, ICU, maternity ward, and localized public audits. No citizen should travel more than 15 minutes for emergency care.

clinic.title: 1 Clinic per Ward
clinic.desc: Primary healthcare within walking distance. OPD, basic diagnostics, pharmacy, and vaccination centre in every ward.

oldAge.title: 1 Old Age Home per Vidhan Sabha
oldAge.desc: Dignified elderly care with medical support, recreational facilities, and community integration programs.

rehab.title: 1 Rehabilitation Centre per Vidhan Sabha
rehab.desc: Professional addiction recovery and mental health support. No more ignoring the crisis destroying our youth.

shelter.title: 1 Homeless Shelter per Vidhan Sabha
shelter.desc: Dignified shelter with meals, medical access, job training, and a path to rehabilitation.

library.title: 1 Library + Skill Centre per Ward
library.desc: Free internet, digital literacy, vocational training, and competitive exam preparation for every citizen.

Manifesto.title: The Nagrik Manifesto
Manifesto.subtitle: Our public declarations and policy blueprints.
Manifesto.content: We are building policies from the ground up, based on the actual failures of daily life. Not from think tanks. Not from foreign models. From the streets.

Transparency.title: Donation Transparency
Transparency.subtitle: Every rupee is public record.
Transparency.content: Every rupee given to this movement will be publicly logged. We believe that if you demand accountability from the government, you must first demand it from yourself.

Constitution.title: Party Constitution
Constitution.subtitle: The rules that govern us.
Constitution.content: The structural rules, bylaws, and internal democratic processes of the Nagrik Party. This document ensures no single leader can override the collective movement.

Media.title: Media & Press
Media.subtitle: Official communications.
Media.content: Official press releases, assets, and media statements. For press inquiries, contact our media cell directly.

Contact.title: Contact Headquarters
Contact.subtitle: Reach the movement.
Contact.content: Visit us or reach out to our digital coordination team.
Contact.address: B-80, Street 8, Ghaffar Manzil, Jamia Nagar, Okhla, New Delhi – 110025

Donate.title: Fund the Movement
Donate.content: We do not take corporate money. We run on the small contributions of frustrated citizens who want to see actual change. Your ₹100 is worth more than their millions.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.subtitle: Your data, protected.
Privacy.content: We protect the data of our operatives, volunteers, and reporters with extreme prejudice. Your data is used strictly for organizing local civic action.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.content: We collect only what is necessary for civic organizing: name, contact information, ward/locality, and issue reports you voluntarily submit.

usage.title: How We Use Your Data
usage.content: Your data is used exclusively for: coordinating local civic action, connecting you with ward-level volunteers, and tracking reported civic issues in your area.

sharing.title: Data Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell, trade, or share your personal data with any third party, political entity, or commercial organization. Period.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, modify, or delete your personal data at any time. Contact us at our headquarters to exercise these rights.

Terms.title: Terms & Conditions
Terms.subtitle: Rules of engagement.
Terms.content: By participating in this platform, you agree to uphold the values of civic dignity and non-violent political organizing.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using this platform, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these terms.

conduct.title: Code of Conduct
conduct.content: All participants must maintain civic dignity, refrain from hate speech, and engage in non-violent organizing. Any violation will result in immediate removal.

content.title: User Content
content.content: Issue reports, photographs, and other content you submit must be truthful and documented in good faith. False reporting undermines the movement.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.content: This platform is a civic organizing tool. It does not replace official government complaint mechanisms. We work alongside, not in place of, institutional frameworks.

Leadership.title: Ward Leadership
Leadership.content: We do not have a high command. We have Ward Captains. These are the citizens taking responsibility for their local neighborhoods.
